name: filter-chips
description: Active-filter summary with removable chips and a clear-all action.
designIntent: Filter bars collapse, scroll or hide on mobile, so users lose track of what is applied. FilterChips keeps the active set visible, with one remove action per filter and an optional reset.

props.name: filters
props.description: Active filters: key, label, optional value and onRemove.

props.name: onClearAll
props.description: Shows a clear-all action when provided.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when there are no active filters. Nothing renders when omitted.

examples.title: Applied dashboard filters
examples.code:
<FilterChips
  filters={[
    { key: 'industry', label: 'Industry', value: 'Technology', onRemove: () => remove('industry') },
    { key: 'region', label: 'Region', value: 'Mountain', onRemove: () => remove('region') },
  ]}
  onClearAll={clearAll}
/>
examples.description: A removable summary of two applied filters.

antiPatterns.title: Don't duplicate the filter controls
antiPatterns.explanation: FilterChips summarizes applied filters; the select, slider or segmented control still owns input.

accessibility.implementation: Renders role=group with aria-label Active filters by default
accessibility.userRequirements: Override aria-label when the page has more than one filter summary

accessibility.implementation: Each remove button is named Remove <label>: <value>
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep labels and values short enough to announce clearly

guidelines: Use the same labels as the controls
Show the selected value, not the option list
Use Any only when a filter is explicitly unbounded

compositionRules.relationship: Place FilterChips directly under FilterBar so applied filters remain visible
Use FilterChips to summarize multi-select segments
